description: A freely available best-practices-based eLearning programme developed by Thielmann and colleagues to teach physicians and practice assistants about vaccine cold-chain management.

description: A middle-school substance-use prevention curriculum that teaches refusal, explanation, avoidance, and leaving strategies through interactive classroom sessions, student-produced videos, and booster activities.
title: keepin' it R.E.A.L. (kiR) resistance-skills curriculum

title: Keller et al. (2021) harmonized six-cycle PISA top-performing student dataset

description: A framework issued by the Kentucky Department of Education that defines K–8 computer-science learning standards, including Data & Analysis and Impacts of Computing strands.
title: Kentucky Academic Standards for Computer Science

description: KERMIT is a knowledge-based intelligent tutoring and problem-solving environment developed by Pramuditha Suraweera for university students practising conceptual database design with the Entity-Relationship data model.
title: KERMIT

description: A paired patient-safety assessment consisting of a scenario-based Key Features examination for clinical reasoning and the WHOBARS observational rating scale for checklist-based surgical safety performance.
title: Key Features examination and WHOBARS behavioral rating scale
